event.prompt:
Thorough exploration. I need the EXACT Zod schema definitions for every entity type in compose/js/compose.ts that participates in a KitDiff. For each entity, I need:

1. The Schema definition (exact fields and their types)
2. The DiffSchema definition (what's partial, what's extended)
3. The IdSchema definition (what identifies this entity in a collection diff)

Entities to find:
- Kit (KitSchema)
- Type (TypeSchema) 
- Design (DesignSchema)
- Tag (TagSchema)
- Concept (ConceptSchema)
- Port (PortSchema)
- Quality (QualitySchema)
- Author (AuthorSchema)
- File (FileSchema)
- Folder (FolderSchema)
- Attribute (AttributeSchema)
- Model (ModelSchema)
- Connector (ConnectorSchema)
- Prop (PropSchema)
- Piece (PieceSchema)
- Connection (ConnectionSchema)
- Side (SideSchema)
- Stat (StatSchema)
- Benchmark (BenchmarkSchema)
- Layer (LayerSchema)
- Group (GroupSchema)
- Plane (PlaneSchema)
- Point (PointSchema)
- Vector (VectorSchema)

For each, report the EXACT lines and fields. Pay special attention to:
- Which fields are required vs optional
- Which fields are nullable (z.string().nullable())
- Which fields reference other entities (like TypeId, AuthorId etc.)
- Which fields are arrays

Also find and report:
- The full content of the applyKitDiff function
- The full content of the getKitDiff function  
- The full content of the inverseKitDiff function
- The full content of the areKitDiffsEqual function

Report exact line numbers for everything.
